title: AMC 10 Practice: Counting Non-Squares — The 2026th Number in the List
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on counting non-square numbers, solved by counting gaps between squares and by adding squares back. (Level 4 of 5)
What is the 2026th positive whole number that is not a perfect square? Vantee shows two ways to find it without listing 2026 numbers: count the gaps between the squares, or add back the squares you knocked out. You will see why 2069, 2070, 2072 and 2116 are tempting traps, and get a spot-one-thousand challenge to try yourself.
